alex: Heads up — seeing a sharp latency cliff on mistral-8x7b right after the rope-scale tweak we merged. P50 jumps for single-token requests (warm KV) when seq crosses 2048.

alex: Quick logs:
```
2026-03-17T14:12:05Z | model=m8x7b | seq=2049 | kernel=slow_final_attn | p50=210ms | p95=480ms
2026-03-17T14:12:06Z | model=m8x7b | seq=2048 | kernel=fast_block_attn | p50=48ms | p95=90ms
```

marta: Hmm. My first guess is kernel_selector is misclassifying the RoPE wrap boundary after the scale change and falling back to the generic slow kernel. @ryan can you tail the kernel_selector logs for those traces?

ryan: Running `grep -A3 kernel_choice runtime.log | tail -n 40` — seeing repeated lines like:
```
[14:12:05] kernel_choice: model=m8x7b seq=2049 reason=pos_wrap_candidate=true -> fallback=slow_final_attn
[14:12:05] kernel_choice: candidate_kernels=[fast_block_attn, vectorized_wrap_attn, slow_final_attn]
```

linh: Also noticing increased KV pointer churn when pos wraps. In our code we normalize pointers like:
```
kv_ptr = (pos >= max_pos) ? (pos - max_pos) : pos
```
When rope scale changes the effective position window moves and we get more cache misses (pointer normalization + mismatched cache keys).

perf-bot: Perf summary (canary host m8x7b-canary-02): flamegraph link: https://perf.internal/fg/m8x7b/1934567890, top hotspots: `slow_final_attn` (42%), `kv_map.normalize` (18%), `memcpy` (12%). kernel_fallback_rate spiked from 0.6% -> 19% around 14:11 UTC.

marta: Proposed short-term fix: strengthen kernel_selector heuristic to consider model.config.max_position_embeddings and the rope_scale param (detect when pos_wrap is cosmetic due to scale vs. real wrap). Add a fast-path that handles seq==max_pos+1 transition without falling back.

alex: +1 to that. For safety: do a canary on Dedicated first with synthetic sweep for sequences around boundary. We'll want batch sizes [1,4,8] and seqs 2038..2056.

infra-bot: Canary branch `canary/m8x7b-rope-fix` deployed to dedicated-us-west with monitoring and alerts wired (prom: `m8x7b_kernel_fallback_rate`).

ryan: I'll own the patch. Plan: (1) add unit tests to kernel_selector for rope_scale and max_pos combos, (2) add synthetic perf CI that exercises seq transitions, (3) emit `kernel_fallback_rate` metric to Console and add a short-term alert. Patch PR incoming in ~2h.

alex: Nice. Repro script (local): `/tools/perf/repro_m8x7b_wrap.sh` — includes `--batch-sizes 1,4,8 --seq-range 2038-2056 --repeat 2000`. If this looks green on canary we schedule a hosted rollout with gradual ramp.

marta: Also add logging gate to avoid spam in heavy traffic: only log kernel_choice reasons when fallback happens and trace_id present. :eyes: :thumbsup:
